description: Reverse-ETL / audience activation: upload an upstream DataFrame into a LinkedIn Matched Audiences DMP Segment via POST /rest/dmpSegments/{id}/users (BATCH_CREATE, up to 5,000 per request). Email is SHA-256 hashed (lowercase, all whitespace removed) before upload. Supports 'add' (ADD) and 'remove' (REMOVE). Email is the only supported identifier type -- LinkedIn's API documents no phone identifier.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row contributes a hashed email identifier to the target DMP Segment.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (segment_id / operation / rows_submitted / rows_skipped_no_identifier / api_requests).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

segment_id.label: Segment ID
segment_id.description: Target DMP Segment ID. Must already exist.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> identifier type. Only 'email' is supported.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: 'add' maps to LinkedIn action=ADD; 'remove' maps to action=REMOVE.

linkedin_api_version.label: LinkedIn API Version
linkedin_api_version.description: LinkedIn REST API version header (YYYYMM). LinkedIn sunsets old versions ~12 months after release.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: LinkedIn Matched Audience Upsert
